items.title: Simon Property Group (SPG) Plans To Hand Back Square One Mall
items.summary: Simon Property Group (NYSE: SPG) is reportedly preparing to hand back the Square One Mall in Saugus to its lender. The enclosed regional mall is classified as a Class C property, reflecting weaker tenant quality and softer shopper traffic than higher tier centers. Refinancing the mall has reportedly become difficult, as lenders tighten terms for lower performing retail properties.
